claim: Illustrate a connectivity proposal preceding 3D seed generation and TS validation
title: Bond edits for TS candidate generation
caption: Synthetic concept graphic for a butadiene–ethene cycloaddition. The plus sign separates reactants; dashed blue links in the candidate graph mark proposed C–C connections. Solid edges provide a schematic graph context. Dashed links are an editing convention, not measured partial bonds, fractional bond orders or an optimized TS geometry. Converting a graph into 3D seeds requires a separate embedding procedure, followed by TS optimization, vibrational characterization and IRC endpoint validation. No barrier, yield or success rate is claimed.
